description: Source code for the TMP112 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register read/write, configuration, attribute setting, sampling, and device initialization.

methods.name: tmp112_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit register from the TMP112 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: tmp112_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to a register in the TMP112 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: set_config_flags
methods.description: Sets specific configuration flags in the TMP112 configuration register.

methods.name: tmp112_update_config
methods.description: Updates the sensor's configuration register with new settings.

methods.name: tmp112_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as full scale and sampling frequency.

methods.name: tmp112_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a temperature sample from the sensor.

methods.name: tmp112_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the latest temperature sample as a sensor_value.

methods.name: tmp112_init
methods.description: Initializes the TMP112 device, checking I2C bus readiness and setting default configuration.
